alternating_process_controls.timing_boundary: fresh test process including load, matched n-1/singleton prefill, full logits and serialized-state fingerprints

limitations: One short prompt and four generated tokens per control do not qualify checkpoint quality, long context, MTP combinations, or M5 Ultra.
Full logits and state equality is within a pack under the same prefill schedule, not between quantization formats.
Process timing includes loading, matched prefill, logits/state hashing and serialization. It is not model throughput or an mlx_lm comparison.

Filesystem cache was not controlled. The final repeated whole-layer run encountered concurrent host rsync and indexing activity; causality and volume contention were not established. Retain all observations without treating medians as a clean speedup benchmark.
Payload counters measure successful logical row reads, not physical device I/O, read-ahead, peak memory, or a guarantee on failed partial reads.

The fingerprint binary predates worker-local and server telemetry plus additional tests; model and gather arithmetic are unchanged. The server includes telemetry and predates only a test assertion style fix.
Public readiness and default residency policy are unchanged; selected reads remain an explicit development opt-in.
